get_account_info.description: Get an account's state: the program that owns it, its balance, whether it is executable, and its data. Accounts the node can decode (token accounts, mints, stake and vote accounts) come back as readable fields; anything else keeps its data as base64.

parameters.description: Base58 address of the account to read. Any account works: a wallet, a token account, a mint, or a program.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Which Solana cluster to read from. Mainnet is the live chain carrying real value; Devnet and Testnet are for trying a workflow out first and their tokens are worth nothing. Defaults to Mainnet.
parameters.name: cluster

parameters.description: How settled the data has to be before the node answers. 'Finalized' is a block that can no longer be rolled back and is the right choice for anything about money; 'confirmed' is a couple of seconds fresher; 'processed' is the newest and the least certain. executable.description: Whether the account is a program itself

sol.description: The same amount expressed in SOL

description: Read the Solana blockchain through its keyless public JSON-RPC endpoints: SOL and SPL token balances, one account or a hundred at once, a wallet's recent transactions and what each one moved, transaction statuses, blocks, staking rewards, validators, SOL supply and inflation, priority fees, and cluster health. No account or API key required.
